items.title: Epic Seven Adds Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine As Secret Rabbit Hole Side Story Continues
‘Epic Seven’ New “Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine” Hero Out Now
items.summary: This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate rolled out the red carpet for their latest heroine "Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine" in their
items.content:
This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate rolled out the red carpet for their latest heroine “Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine” in their long-running turn-based role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’. Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine is a key character in the Special Side Story “Secret Rabbit Hole,” which has been ongoing since the 29th of October (where it also launched on Steam)! In said story, she appears as a mob boss who leads her syndicate with fierce charisma—ruthless to traitors, yet willing to risk her life to protect her subordinates. What a hero!

She is a 5★ Ice elemental Knight Hero capable of elevating her party’s combat power by decreasing damage suffered by allies, increasing Combat Readiness, and granting Increased Attack. Most notably, she grants herself “Determination” when an ally dies. While granted Determination, using her basic skill “Initiation” will activate “Settlement” as an extra attack, dealing damage that penetrates Defense to all enemies.

Meanwhile, the Special Side Story “Secret Rabbit Hole” will run until 10 December. By progressing through the story, players can acquire three pieces of Level 88 Equipment. Players who collect all three new Bunny Girl Heroes and two skins will also receive a special Pet.

Epic Seven is a free-to-play title that is available across PC (Windows) via Steam / STOVE , iOS (macOS supported), and Android via Google Play .

items.title: Epic Seven Updates Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine
items.summary: Smilegate announced on November 6 that it has updated its mobile turn-based strategy RPG Epic Seven, developed by Super Creative, with the new Hero 'Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine'.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on Smilegate announced on November 6 that it has updated its mobile turn-based strategy RPG Epic Seven, developed by Super Creative, with the new Hero 'Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine'. She is a 5-star Ice-element Knight Hero who reduces damage taken by allies while boosting their Combat Readiness and Attack.

The Special Side Story 'Secret Rabbit Hole', featuring Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine, runs from October 29 to December 10. Players can progress through the story to acquire three types of Level 88 equipment. Collecting all three new Bunny Girl Heroes and two skins will also reward players with a special Pet.

In battle, she utilizes the 'Determination' effect granted to herself when an ally dies. When using her basic skill 'Initiation' while in the 'Determination' state, she additionally triggers 'Settlement', dealing defense-penetrating damage to all enemies.

As a central figure in 'Secret Rabbit Hole', Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine appears as the boss leading the syndicate. She is portrayed as a character who risks her life to protect her subordinates while showing a cold demeanor toward traitors.

Detailed information about the game can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Is Now Playable on PC via Steam Without Needing Mobile Devices
items.summary: Epic Seven is live on Steam with the new Foundry server, settlement events and the Secret Rabbit Hole side story, running October 29 to December 10.
items.content:
Gaming Epic Seven Is Now Playable on PC via Steam Without Needing Mobile Devices GameDaily Follow Franz Christian Irorita Sun, November 1, 2026 at 4:09 AM UTC Sun, November 1, 2026 at 4:09 AM UTC *]:pointer-events-auto hidden md:block"> Epic Seven Is Now Playable on PC via Steam Without Needing Mobile Devices Epic Seven is now on Steam. Smilegate's mobile turn-based strategy RPG officially launched on the platform on October 29, and it opened a brand-new server called Foundry to welcome the incoming players.

Smilegate calls the Steam launch part of a platform expansion for global players, and says the Steam version adds exclusive features such as controller support. The game is free to play on its Steam page , and Smilegate says more than 100,000 players joined the Steam Wishlist Event that began in August.

Foundry can be reached through Steam, the STOVE PC client, and mobile devices. For a limited time, first-time players on the new server get independent matchmaking in PvP content.

A Settlement Support Buff Event that began on October 29 speeds up Hero and account growth, and the event gives a 30% EXP boost for new-server players. It comes with daily free Hero summons, plus Equipment, growth materials, and Hero Skins for logging in and playing content.

The Special Side Story Secret Rabbit Hole runs from October 29 to December 10. Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro and her sidekick Alencia investigate a plot uncovered during a victory celebration party, piecing together the hidden truth behind the case.

Progressing through the story earns three pieces of Level 88 Equipment. Collect all three new Bunny Girl characters and two skins, and you will receive a special Pet. The "Trusty Sidekick Alencia's Case Files" and "Lucky Board Party!" events run alongside it with Charms and Emojis as extra rewards.

For more on where the game is headed, read about the 8th anniversary update that first revealed the Steam plans, and see how Smilegate showed up for Chaos Zero Nightmare at Anime Expo. Will you start fresh on Foundry?

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ Out Now on Steam, World Championship Knockout Stage Details
items.summary: Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title 'Epic Seven' is now
items.content:
Today, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate announced that their free-to-play turn-based strategy role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ is now available on PC via Steam , joining the STOVE client as a new way to play the game. This launch also marks the launch of a new server dubbed “Foundry”. The publisher writes that the “Steam launch is part of a platform expansion reflecting the needs of global players”. With Epic Seven now available on Steam, the world’s largest gaming platform, long-term positive synergy is expected from a new influx of players and improved accessibility. Furthermore, the Steam server introduces exclusive new features, such as controller support. Additionally, a new Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” is live from 29 October to the 10th of December. The Knockout stage of the World Championships are also underway! Though the gist of that is that for the next few weekends, matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch —beginning at 03:00 UTC. More details on that can be found below. Epic Seven is a free-to-play title that is available across PC (Windows) via Steam / STOVE , iOS (macOS supported), and Android via Google Play .

The new “Foundry” server, launched alongside the Steam service, can be accessed not only through Steam but also via the STOVE PC Client and mobile devices. For players starting Epic Seven for the first time, the new server will operate with independent matchmaking for PvP content for a limited time.

Additionally, various events will be held on the new server to help players settle in quickly. A Settlement Support Buff Event, which began on the 29th, provides various effects to accelerate Hero and account growth, along with daily free Hero summons. There will also be bountiful rewards provided, including various Equipment, growth materials, and Hero Skins, when players log in or play through content.

Global player response has also been highly positive, with over 100,000 players participating in the Steam Wishlist Event that began in August.

Meanwhile, Epic Seven will release a Special Side Story, “Secret Rabbit Hole,” from Oct. 29 to Dec. 10. The greatest Bunny detective, Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro, alongside her sidekick, Alencia, will investigate various incidents to stop a plot detected during a victory celebration party, uncovering the hidden truth behind the case along the way.

Players can earn three pieces of Level 88 Equipment by progressing through the story and will receive a special Pet upon collecting all three new Bunny Girl characters and two skins. Additional rewards, such as Charms and Emojis, can also be earned through the concurrent “Trusty Sidekick Alencia’s Case Files” and “Lucky Board Party!” events.

E7WC determines the ultimate global champion of Epic Seven ‘s real-time PvP mode, World Arena. The Knockout Stage will feature 16 players: the 14 survivors from the two-week Group Stage, along with Hazamarei and MagicQi, who secured their Knockout Stage seeds by placing first and second in the newly established online league, “ Epic Seven Masters 2026.”

The Group Stage, held over four days on October 10 (Sat), 11 (Sun), 17 (Sat), and 18 (Sun), delivered incredible matches and top-tier entertainment for Epic Seven fans. In particular, defending champion XiaoXuenai faced elimination after a loss to FN in the Upper Bracket but rallied to win the final match, proving the resilience of a true champion by advancing to the Knockout Stage. In addition, OMEGA from Group E made headlines with an incredible comeback victory, perfectly utilizing “Salome”—a Hero capable of cloning target Heroes—from a heavily disadvantaged position.

The Knockout Stage will be held every weekend at 03:00 UTC for about four weeks, from October 24 to November 14. Like the Group Stage, it will follow a Double-Elimination format to determine the Top 4 players who will advance to the Finals, held at the Lotte Cinema World Tower SUPER PLEX in Jamsil, Korea, on November 28. All matches will be broadcast live in four languages on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel and Twitch .

Smilegate will run a Drops event for viewers tuning in via Twitch and reveal coupon codes during the live broadcast. Additionally, Smilegate will hold an in-game Match Prediction event, allowing players to predict match results and earn rewards.

The narrative follows 'Bunny Girl Great Detective Moro' and her assistant 'Alencia' as they investigate an incident to prevent a terrorist attack detected during a victory party. Over the course of their investigation, the two uncover the full truth behind the hidden event.

During the same period, the 'Trusty Sidekick Alencia's Case Files Event' and the 'Lucky Board Party Event' will offer additional rewards such as enhancement stones and emojis. Detailed information about the game can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Pity Odds: 1.5% Rate, $302 Guarantee [2026]
items.summary: Epic Seven's 1.5% base rate has no 50/50 — 121 pulls guarantees your hero for 02-18. See the full cost table and EV math.
items.content:
Epic Seven’s gacha has one feature that sets it apart from almost every other anime-style gacha on the market: there is no 50/50 coin flip. The short answer for anyone deciding whether to chase a specific hero is this – Smilegate sets the base rate for a 5-star hero at 1.5% per pull on a Covenant pickup banner, and backs that up with a hard, deterministic guarantee at 121 pulls that hands you the exact featured hero, not a random 5-star from the wider pool. Priced out in real money, that guarantee runs roughly $302 to $318 depending on how you buy your Skystones, based on Epic Seven’s own currency shop and current App Store pricing.

How Epic Seven’s Summon System Works The Base 5-Star Rate: What 1.5% Really Means Epic Seven’s Biggest Difference: No 50/50 Coin Flip The 121-Pull Hard Pity, Explained Pull-by-Pull Probability Table What It Costs: Skystones, Bookmarks, and the Math Between Them The Pity-Cost Table: Currency and Real Cash at Every Milestone Step-by-Step Expected Value Calculation Five Worked Examples: What Different Budgets Actually Buy How Epic Seven Compares to Other Gacha Pity Systems Myths vs. Facts About Epic Seven’s Gacha Is Chasing a Specific Hero in Epic Seven Worth It? Frequently Asked Questions What is Epic Seven’s base rate for a 5-star hero? Does Epic Seven have a 50/50 system? How many pulls does it take to guarantee a featured hero? How much does it cost to guarantee a hero in Epic Seven? Is it cheaper to buy Skystones in bulk? When does soft pity start in Epic Seven? Is Epic Seven’s rate disclosure considered reliable? Should I save Skystones for a specific banner, or spend as I go? Related Coverage That’s the headline. The rest of this piece walks through where those numbers come from, what a pull-by-pull probability curve looks like under the published 1.5% base rate, a step-by-step expected-value calculation, a worked pity-cost table priced in both Skystones and dollars, and five spending scenarios so you can judge whether saving up for one hero is worth it before you open your wallet.

Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.

Epic Seven runs its gacha through “Covenant Summons,” which pull from a shared pool of heroes and artifacts. A single summon costs 5 Covenant Bookmarks, and Bookmarks are bought with Skystones, the game’s premium currency, according to BlueStacks’ Epic Seven beginner’s guide . The in-game shop sells 5 Bookmarks for 100 Skystones at the standard rate, or 50 Bookmarks for 950 Skystones as a bulk option, which works out to 95 Skystones per summon instead of 100, per Epic7DB’s currency guide .

The week's biggest stories in tech, gaming and security, in one email.

The banner that matters most for anyone chasing a specific hero is the Covenant “Drop Rate Up” banner, sometimes called a pickup banner, which rotates roughly every one to two weeks and features a single highlighted 5-star hero. As of early September 2026, that rotation included heroes like Uncharted Pioneer Politis on a Drop Rate Up banner starting September 3, and Lisette on a Mystic pull banner from late August, according to the Epic Seven Wiki’s heroes hub , confirming the game is still actively live-serviced with fresh banners rather than winding down.

Every Covenant pickup summon draws from a rarity table where the top tier, 5-star heroes, sits at a flat base rate of roughly 1.5% before any pity boost kicks in, according to a September 2026 update to the Epic Seven Wiki’s summons and pity guide . That rate has crept upward over the game’s history. Older third-party breakdowns from 2019 and 2020 cited figures closer to 1.25% to 1.4% for a 5-star hero, so the current 1.5% figure reflects a modest rate increase Smilegate has made to the base odds over time, not a number that’s stayed frozen since launch.

What makes that 1.5% figure different from base rates in most other gacha games is what happens after it hits. In games like Genshin Impact or Honkai: Star Rail, a 5-star pull is often followed by a second roll of the dice over which specific unit you actually receive. Epic Seven skips that step entirely on pickup banners, which is the single biggest reason its pity math is simpler to calculate than almost anything else in the genre.

Most modern gacha systems layer a 50/50 mechanic on top of their pity count: hit the top rarity, and there’s roughly a coin-flip chance it’s the character the banner is actually selling rather than a generic unit from the standard pool. Epic Seven doesn’t do that on its Covenant pickup banners. The Epic Seven Wiki states it plainly: “Covenant pickup pity is 121 pulls and there is no 50/50,” and that if the banner has a featured hero up, “the 121st yellow is that hero.”

That single design choice changes the entire cost calculation compared to a game like Genshin Impact’s 50/50 pity system , where losing the coin flip can force a second full pity cycle before you’re guaranteed the unit you actually wanted. In Epic Seven, once you’ve committed to a pickup banner, every pull that doesn’t land a 5-star still counts toward the same 121-pull counter, and there’s no branch where you land the top rarity and still walk away without the hero you were saving for.

Epic Seven layers a soft pity ramp on top of the flat base rate starting around pull 100, and that ramp climbs until it reaches a deterministic guarantee at pull 121, per the Epic Seven Wiki’s summons documentation. Put simply: if you haven’t landed the featured hero by your 120th pull on a given pickup banner, your 121st summon is that hero, full stop, no roll involved.

Smilegate hasn’t published the exact per-pull rate curve for the 21 pulls between where soft pity starts and where hard pity locks in, so this article doesn’t estimate specific percentages for that stretch. What’s confirmed is the start point (around pull 100), the endpoint (pull 121, guaranteed), and that the climb in between only raises your odds, never lowers them. That’s enough to build a conservative, fully sourced cost model without guessing at numbers nobody has published.

Using the flat 1.5% base rate that applies through pull 99 (before soft pity begins), the cumulative chance of landing the featured hero at least once follows the standard formula for repeated independent draws: 1 minus (0.985 raised to the power of the pull count). Here’s how that curve looks at common milestones.

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.
